t: This is the statue of William IV, which stands in King William Walk in Greenwich. It dates from eighteen forty-four and is the work of the English sculptor Samuel Nixon. It was moved here in nineteen thirty-six from an earlier spot in central London. William was the third son of George the Third, and he became King of the United Kingdom and of Hanover in eighteen thirty. He was the last king of the House of Hanover in Britain, and he reigned until his death in eighteen thirty-seven.
